claims.statement: For Q=product_i((1+z)^{r_i}+z), where m>=1 and each r_i is in {2,3,4}, Q >= coefficientwise binom(m,h) z^h(1+z)^{N-4h} for every integer h>=0 with 4h<=N, where N=sum_i r_i. Consequently, for N>=12 and 1<=j<=floor(2N/3), [z^j]Q>=m binom(N-4,j-1)>0 and [z^j](z(1+z)^{N+1})/[z^j]Q<=24^5/m.
